scope: Native PostgreSQL 17, isolated disposable loopback cluster, minimal matching table fixture; full Supabase migration suite and production rollout remain separate.

tests.name: database validator accepts all eight current registry snapshots
anonymous and authenticated roles cannot execute command or read receipts
broad default table privileges cannot grant direct service-role receipt writes
service role atomically initializes four missing groups, histories, audits and receipt
service role can read a receipt but cannot alter or remove it
existing append-only audit protection remains compatible with command inserts
identical retry returns original receipt despite now-stale expected versions
object key ordering does not change an idempotent receipt
request reuse with changed payload, expected version, actor or action conflicts
reject partial group permissions without writes
reject no console permission without writes
reject restore permission without group management without writes
reject group management without restore permission without writes
authorization is rechecked on an otherwise identical retry
revoked group permission also blocks a previously successful retry
input boundary: invalid dashboard nested field
input boundary: invalid dashboard duplicate widget
reject null actor, request ID and change type
a stale version in the last group rolls back the entire command
all eight groups publish together and history matches stored snapshots
restore writes the restore action and snapshot in the same transaction
forced settings_versions failure rolls back settings, history, audit and receipt
forced audit_logs failure rolls back settings, history, audit and receipt
forced system_settings_commands failure rolls back settings, history, audit and receipt
two simultaneous commands using the same versions allow exactly one winner
simultaneous retries of a new request create a single receipt and version set
opposite group order waits on one command lock then conflicts without deadlock
